title: De mes amours / Lautrier mestuet uenue / Defors compeigne (anonymous, Montpellier Codex)
desc: Anonymous, De mes amours / Lautrier mestuet uenue / Defors compeigne. 3 voices (Triplum, Motetus, Tenor), each on its own staff. Transcribed from the original mensural notation at the original pitch; note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), a perfect value written with a dot. The tenor is a chant melody laid out in a repeated rhythm.
